title: Utah FORGE 2024 stimulations: Microseismic event catalog from seismic surface network
scope: April 2024 Utah FORGE, surface-network catalog, times in UTC. Magnitudes calibrated to UUSS local magnitudes. Local coordinates referenced to well 16A(78)-32. For site holdout, group with FORGE2022; the two campaigns are disjoint in time.

hydraulic_source.creator: Kevin England, Energy and Geoscience Institute at the University of Utah
hydraulic_source.clock_note: Calfrac readmes specify Mountain Standard Time (UTC-07). The independent GDR fused table also maps 2024-04-03 10:09:14 instrument time to 17:09:14 UTC. Use unsmoothed original clean fluid rate in US oil barrels/minute.
